info.name: Anakin API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the [Anakin](https://anakin.io) REST API: scrape any URL into Markdown, HTML or JSON, search the web, crawl and map sites, run agentic research, and call Wire actions across 940+ sites. Proxies, JavaScript rendering, anti-bot handling and CAPTCHA solving are done for you.

## Get started

1. Get an API key at [anakin.io/account](https://anakin.io/account#developer). New accounts get 300 free credits, no card required.
2. Select the **Anakin** environment and paste the key into `apiKey` (keep it as a secret value).
3. Send **URL Scraper / Scrape URL (inline)**.

No key yet? Requests marked "No API key needed" (Wire discovery, `wire-run`, inline scrape) work without one. See the **Anakin Quickstart** collection.

## Authentication

Every request sends the `X-API-Key` header (set at collection level from `{{apiKey}}`).

## Async jobs

Scrape, batch, map, crawl, agentic search and Wire tasks return a job id. Each submit request saves that id to a collection variable, so you can send the matching **Get ... result** request right after. Poll until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.

## Links

- [API reference](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference)
- [Error responses](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/error-responses)
- [Pricing](https://anakin.io/pricing)
- [MCP server](https://anakin.io/docs) (`https://mcp.anakin.io/mcp`)

item.name: URL Scraper
item.description: Scrape a page into Markdown, cleaned HTML, or structured JSON. Handles proxies, JavaScript rendering, and anti-bot protection.

request.description:
Scrape one URL and get the result in the same response, no polling. Works without an API key on the free Zero Touch trial; add `X-API-Key` for full limits.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/url-scraper/scrape](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/url-scraper/scrape)

Submit an asynchronous scrape job. Returns a `jobId`; poll **Get scrape result**. The job id is saved to the `scrapeJobId` collection variable.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/url-scraper/submit-scrape-job](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/url-scraper/submit-scrape-job)

Scrape up to many URLs in one job. Poll **Get scrape result** with the returned `jobId`.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/url-scraper/batch-url-scraping](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/url-scraper/batch-url-scraping)

Poll a scrape or batch job. `status` moves from `pending`/`processing` to `completed` or `failed`.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/url-scraper/get-job-status](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/url-scraper/get-job-status)

Download the screenshot captured for a scrape job. Use `type=fullpage` for a full-page capture.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/url-scraper/get-screenshot](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/url-scraper/get-screenshot)

item.name: Wire / Discovery
item.description: Wire turns 940+ sites into API actions. Discovery is public: no API key needed.

request.description:
Find Wire actions for a plain-language intent. Returns `action_id`s and their params. No API key needed.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/search-actions](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/search-actions)

List every site Wire supports. No API key needed.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/list-catalogs](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/list-catalogs)

Actions, parameters, credit cost, and auth requirement for one site. No API key needed.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/get-catalog](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/get-catalog)

item.name: Wire / Run
item.description: Run Wire actions. `wire-run` is the synchronous, keyless, read-only mode; `wire/task` is the keyed, asynchronous mode for write actions and account-connected runs.

request.description:
Run a read-only Wire action synchronously with no API key. The result comes back inline.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire)

Run any Wire action asynchronously. Auth-gated actions need a `credential_id` (see **Wire / Identities**). The `job_id` is saved to `wireJobId`.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/execute-task](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/execute-task)

Poll a Wire job (about once a second, capped at 60/min per user).

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/get-job](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/get-job)

Download the file produced by a Wire job, when the action returns one.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/get-job-download](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/get-job-download)

Ask Anakin to build a Wire action for a site that is not in the catalog yet.

Docs: [https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/create-build-request](https://anakin.io/docs/api-reference/wire/create-build-request)
